rationale: Prakash builds practical web applications with React and full-stack JavaScript expertise, while Marco's Daily's provides communication APIs and developer tools—creating a natural fit for Prakash to integrate real-time communications into his streaming and content management solutions. Both are San Francisco-based founders/CEOs, and Marco's infrastructure could directly enhance the technical capabilities of Prakash's projects.
intro_message: Prakash, meet Marco Gonzalez Hauger — he's CEO of Daily's, building communication APIs that could power the streaming and content features you're working on.
